Game Overview

In Skeleton Knight, the core idea is straightforward: navigate a dark world as the heroic Skeleton Knight in this thrilling arcade game. Evade relentless zombies with strategic maneuvers and quick thinking. Discover safe zones, predict enemy moves, and escalate the challenge at every level while earning points for your survival prowess. Can you master the undead apocalypse?
